title: The Ice Bridge
text: A bridge of clear ice spans the chasm, thin as glass, creaking in the wind. Frozen inside it are other travellers, dozens of them, caught mid-stride, still walking. Their eyes are open. Some of them are looking up at you.

options.label: Cross quickly, over the frozen faces.

outcomes.text: Across, with the frozen faces watching every step, and one of them blinking.
The ice cracks under the slowest, and a frozen hand reaches up through the crack.
Safe, but the cold gets into them, and stays.

options.label: The strongest cuts a traveler out of the ice.

outcomes.text: They thaw, gasping, and give thanks with a ring.
They thaw, and they are not grateful at all.
